title: Nightscape - A cozy endless flight above storm clouds
author: Haru-tan

comments.author: couldgiveaflyingfck
comments.body: Gorgeous, isn't it? I found myself just staring, jaw dropped, at the sheer beauty of it all. Is this entirely 3D? It's an engine, right? I could easily envision this as a soothing backdrop for some Ambient Techno, perhaps even drift off to sleep to it. Would you consider making this available for free, or perhaps sharing it? If so, could you include an option to integrate a radio station, like SomaFM, with a playlist that complements the atmosphere? I'd love to have something like this on my TV for those nights when I need a little extra help unwinding. Let's take a look at the movies out.

replies.author: Haru-tan
replies.body: There is a link to the demo and the repository if you click through to the original post.  You are absolutely welcome to fork it and do as you please. :)
